google-lakehouse-runtime-catalog:managed.notes: Managed Lakehouse runtime catalog (formerly BigLake metastore, renamed April 2026; APIs and IAM still say biglake).

google-lakehouse-runtime-catalog:serves-.notes: Two paths: IRC-native runtime-catalog tables are externally read and write with spec-compliant vended credentials, while BigQuery-managed (federated) Iceberg is read-only to external engines with no credential vending.

google-lakehouse-runtime-catalog:rw-fore.notes: No GA path to read or write foreign tables via IRC: cross-cloud Lakehouse (an IRC client to Unity and Glue) is Preview and read-only.

google-lakehouse-runtime-catalog:federat.notes: No GA catalog-of-catalogs IRC brokering; cross-cloud Lakehouse brokers external Unity and Glue catalogs but is Preview, so it is not credited.

google-lakehouse-runtime-catalog:multi-e.notes: Multi-engine is GA (Spark, Flink, Hive, Trino and BigQuery share the same tables), but catalog-managed storage is GCS-only and multi-cloud reads go through BigQuery Omni external tables, not the IRC catalog.

google-lakehouse-runtime-catalog:governa.notes: No row-level security on managed Iceberg, and IRC-native tables have no fine-grained row/column access control either.
